conventions.convention: Associated bundles use [ph,w]=[p,ρ(h)w]. If local sections satisfy s_i=s_j g_ji, the transition from i-coordinates to j-coordinates is ρ(g_ji). Complex multiplication is J[p,w]=[p,iw].

Background geometry is Euclidean, oriented, smooth and four-dimensional; the default manifold is nonempty, Hausdorff, second-countable and boundaryless. Spin structures, connections and model-specific spinor equations are supplied inputs.
Use c=ℏ=1. The S4 radius has length units, the Yang–Mills coupling is dimensionless, the normalized background ε is dimensionless, and Qε has mass dimension 1/2.

The selected global gauge group is SU(2), with anti-Hermitian generators T_a=-iσ_a/2 and κ(X,Y)=-2Tr₂(XY). The flat Minkowski N=4 supplier supplies component content and normalization, rather than the curved S4 action.

Gauge transformations act by δ_gauge(u)X=[u,X] on adjoint tensors and δ_gauge(u)A=-D_Au on connections. The source covariant Lie derivative is L_v^lift+δ_gauge(κ_v), where κ_v=v·A-β_v,P+vᴬΦ_A and φ=-κ_v.
The R generator uses the ordered bilinear R^Q_AB=2εΓ̃_ABε̃. The combined differential is Q=s+δ; its square is δ_gauge(a₀)+δ_U(1)(ω). Ghosts have no R action, and δφ=-[c,φ]+ρ_gh(ω)c.

Sectorwise lifts, gauge charts, reduced determinants, functional measures and the S4 noncommutative regulator extension are formal model inputs. The ordinary finite-dimensional Cartan complex concerns the base S4, rather than the field configuration space.

load_bearing.statement: A rigid supersymmetric background supplies fixed geometric and auxiliary data, a nonzero smooth spinor in a declared representation, and its exact model-specific linear spinor equation. A localization package additionally supplies the multiplet and off-shell square, configuration space, action, gauge fixing, ghosts, contour, boundary conditions, and measure or regulator; no existence or analytic validity is inferred.

Adopts the selected Euclidean massless N=4 SU(2) model on round S4, including its curved action, conformal Killing spinors, seven localization auxiliaries, sectorwise lifts and gauge fixing, and total differential Q=s+δ with Q²=δ_gauge(a₀)+δ_U(1)(ω). Measures and the S4 regulator extension remain formal assumptions.

For a smooth right principal H-bundle and a smooth finite-dimensional complex representation ρ on W, the real associated bundle admits the well-defined smooth map J[p,w]=[p,iw], with J²=-id, giving a complex vector bundle of rank dim_C W and transition maps ρ(g_ji). No uniqueness among other complex structures is asserted.

concerns.concern: The instruction 'Take dimensionless gauge-fixing parameters ξ₁,ξ₂>0' conflicts with the displayed gauge fermion and declared physical dimensions. Q=s+δ has mass dimension 1/2; sc=φ and Q²=δ_gauge(a₀)+δ_U(1)(ω) give [c]=1/2 and [φ]=[a₀]=1. Since S_gf^Q contains -(φ,ã₀-ξ₂a₀/2)_P with the explicitly unnormalized four-dimensional L² pairing, a dimensionless action requires [ã₀]=3 and [ξ₂]=2. With ξ₂ dimensionless that term has mass dimension -2 instead. A radius factor or a different explicitly normalized pairing is missing; ghost and zero-mode dimensions should be stated consistently.

The source metadata names 'Vasilis Peelaers'; the linked PDF title page identifies lectures by Wolfger Peelaers and notes by Bruno Le Floch. The same incorrect first name occurs in def-qftx-susy-background-data and ex-qftx-susy-round-s4-localization-data. See [the notes, title page](https://indico.math.cnrs.fr/event/3026/attachments/2163/2457/Peelaers-LectureNotes.pdf).

seams_checked.note: Opened post-qftx-n4-super-yang-mills-model. The background accurately retains its SU(2), trace, coupling, scalar-normalization and multiplet interfaces, while explicitly distinguishing its flat Minkowski action from the separately adopted curved action.

Opened def-torus-equivariant-cohomology-cartan-model. The postulate uses only its finite-dimensional smooth compact-torus Cartan data and makes no Borel–Cartan comparison or field-space measure inference.
The round-S4 example's A5–A7 and Verification 1.1 faithfully check the actual N=4 supplier's group, normalization and component content, without claiming its adopted extended invariance was proved.
The round-S4 example's F2 and Verification 4.1 restrict the Cartan construction to the smooth circle action on S4 and explicitly exclude transfer to infinite-dimensional field space.

Opened the fluctuation definition and regulated Ward theorem. They preserve the total square, lifted versus covariant Lie-derivative distinction, affine ghost rule and formal status of continuum inputs; the Ward conclusion requires separately supplied finite-dimensional regulator hypotheses.

Opened post-qftx-s4-n2-localization-model. It uses the background definition for spin geometry and supplied localization data, and separately adopts its U(2), massive N=2* model rather than attributing that model to the SU(2), massless N=4 postulate.

Opened both physical-index definitions. Their background references concern supplied spin/R geometry and model-specific equations, with no arbitrary-background existence claim or inference that the S4 functional integral constructs their Hilbert spaces.
